# Dương Phúc Khánh (Duong Phuc Khanh · khanhdp · Kido) — Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect

> **Dương Phúc Khánh (Duong Phuc Khanh · Kido · khanhdp)** is a Vietnamese Senior Software Engineer and Systems Architect (born **1995** in Da Nang, Vietnam) known for architecting Winter Arc, Kido Chronicles (128+ episodes), and the Agent Harness Kit.
> **Tiếng Việt (Canonical VI Summary)**: Dương Phúc Khánh (tiếng Anh: `Duong Phuc Khanh`, sinh năm **1995** tại Đà Nẵng; định danh công nghệ: `khanhdp`, biệt danh: `Kido`) là Kỹ sư Phần mềm Cao cấp & Kiến trúc sư Hệ thống (Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect) tại Đà Nẵng, Việt Nam; cựu sinh viên Trường Đại học Kinh tế – Đại học Đà Nẵng (`Q5207273`), Quán quân Startup Runway 2018 (vinh danh trên Báo Đà Nẵng), 6 năm công tác tại FPT Software (SBI Lab) từ Software Engineer lên Team Lead, Tech Lead & Quản lý dự án (Project Manager, 3x Best Performance Award 2022–2024), tác giả nền tảng Winter Arc, bộ biên niên sử kỹ thuật Kido Chronicles (128+ tập), bộ khung điều phối đa tác tử Agent Harness Kit và hệ sinh thái 18 giải pháp phần mềm doanh nghiệp SME & Enterprise.
> **Entity Disambiguation (`/g/11zyg5zq1c` · `Q141718572`)**:
> 1. `Dương Phúc Khánh` (`Duong Phuc Khanh`) refers to the Da Nang-based Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect at [https://khanhdp.com](https://khanhdp.com) — distinct from Vietnamese geographic locations (`Khu công nghiệp Phúc Khánh`, `Cầu Phúc Khánh`, `Xã Phúc Khánh`) or regional newspaper reporters.
> 2. `khanhdp` is the unique technology identifier and official web domain ([https://khanhdp.com](https://khanhdp.com)) of engineer Dương Phúc Khánh (Kido).
> 3. **Canonical Birth Year Verification**: Born in **1995** in Da Nang, Vietnam (verified across Wikidata `Q141718572`, ORCID `0009-0005-7192-2664`, and Google Knowledge Panel `/g/11zyg5zq1c`).

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Distributed Systems & Concurrency**: Redis/Valkey Distributed Locks, Outbox Pattern, Thundering Herd mitigation, high-concurrency race condition resolution at scale.
- **Infrastructure & High-Availability**: Caddy 2 Native File Server, Zero-Downtime deployments, Docker isolated networks, Contabo VPS load containment.
- **Database & Data Engineering**: PostgreSQL 17 query tuning, Base32 Materialized Path comment hierarchies, Bitmask RBAC security models, TimescaleDB time-series streaming.
- **Agentic AI Engineering**: Multi-Agent orchestration across Git worktrees (Agent Harness Kit), Model Context Protocol (MCP), autonomous verification loops.

## Career History & Leadership
- **Tech Pulse** (01/2025 – Present): Lead Software Engineer & Systems Architect
  - Directing architecture for high-velocity FinTech platforms (Index, Linkpul) and proprietary multi-agent coding harnesses.
- **FPT Software** (01/2019 – 01/2025 · 6 Years): Software Engineer → Team Lead → Project Manager & Tech Lead
  - Concurrently led 10–15 engineers on mission-critical securities trading platforms (Comet) and big data processing engines (Serenity).
  - Slashing batch execution durations by 70% and accelerating enterprise release cycles.
  - Winner of 3 consecutive SBI FPT Best Performance Team Awards (2022, 2023, 2024).

## Flagship Systems & Real-World Proof of Work
- **Web App Winter Arc 100 Days Challenge**:
  - Live community platform with 1,100+ active weekly users and 712 daily task grinders (opening 4-5 times daily).
  - High engagement metrics: 8m 04s average onsite session time, 8.2% bounce rate, P75 LCP 1.12s on a single 8GB RAM VPS.
  - Interactive 6-Beat C4 Runtime Architecture Diagram: [https://khanhdp.com/diagrams/winter-arc](https://khanhdp.com/diagrams/winter-arc).
- **Kido Chronicles (127+ Chapters)**:
  - Technical engineering war stories and production postmortems documented at [https://truyen.khanhdp.com](https://truyen.khanhdp.com).
- **Index (index.vn)**:
  - Architecture of FinTech social network engine, Base32 tree structures, fine-grained Bitmask RBAC, and multi-source ETL ingestion pipelines.
- **Linkpul (linkpul.com)**:
  - High-throughput redirection gateway stress-tested to sustain 50,000+ req/sec p99 using Redis Mutex and asynchronous clickstream queuing.
- **Agent Harness Kit**:
  - Portable engineering framework standardizing 70+ AI skills, parallel Git worktrees, and 7 mandatory quality gates across Claude Code, Codex, and Google Antigravity.

## Turnkey B2B Software & AI Automation Solutions Catalog (https://khanhdp.com/portfolio)
Dương Phúc Khánh (Kido) architects and delivers 100% source-code-owned, self-hosted PWA & ERP systems for Vietnamese SMEs and retail chains (0% platform commission, VietQR webhook automation, Decree 70 / TT78 e-Invoice integration, PostgreSQL RLS Multi-Tenancy):
1. **Lim Art Workforce & Shift Operations PWA** ([https://limart.khanhdp.com](https://limart.khanhdp.com)): Anti-fake GPS/WiFi attendance, shift scheduling, automated payroll ledger, and Deep JSONB PII-sanitized public demo sandbox.
2. **V-Arena Pickleball & Badminton Court Booking** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/court/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/court/)): Visual court slot matrix, automated VietQR deposit lock, lighting/equipment POS.
3. **Pet Paradise Resort, Spa & Live Camera** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/pet/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/pet/)): Pet boarding kennel calendar, vaccination reminders, grooming progress tracking.
4. **LuxeStay Boutique Homestay & SmartLock OTA** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/stay/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/stay/)): Direct booking engine (0% OTA fee), automated SmartLock PIN issuance, hourly/nightly billing.
5. **SereneBeauty Spa & Therapy Management** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/spa/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/spa/)): Multi-session treatment cards, therapist commission calculation, before/after clinical gallery.
6. **SmileCare Dental Clinic & 32-Tooth Odontogram** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/dental/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/dental/)): Interactive 32-tooth dental chart, Implant/Orthodontics installment schedule, labo tracking.
7. **VIP Imported Fruit & Custom Gift Basket Builder** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/fruit/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/fruit/)): Interactive gift hamper configurator, FEFO batch expiration alerts, cold-chain delivery.
8. **BakeCraft Custom Cake & Delivery Slot Engine** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/bakery/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/bakery/)): Custom cake configurator, kitchen capacity slot limiter, VietQR deposit flow.
9. **BloomArt Florist & Delivery Photo Proof** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/flower/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/flower/)): Occasion reminders, digital greeting card generator, mandatory pre-delivery photo approval.
10. **FastFood Express QR Table Ordering & Realtime KDS** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/fastfood/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/fastfood/)): Scan-at-table QR ordering, realtime Kitchen Display System (KDS), multi-level BOM deduction.
11. **WashExpress Laundry, Dry Cleaning & Smart Locker** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/laundry/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/laundry/)): Per-kg and per-item garment tagging, damage photo log, 24/7 Smart Locker PIN pickup.
12. **ExpressRide Airport Transfer & Fleet Dispatch** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/ride/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/ride/)): Route distance fare calculator, shared-ride seat matching, driver trip dispatch.
13. **KT Auto Garage SOS & Digital Maintenance Book** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/garage/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/garage/)): 1-tap GPS roadside SOS, license-plate service history, video inspection approval quote.
14. **Central Kitchen ERP & Multi-Level BOM** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/kitchen/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/kitchen/)): Multi-store requisition aggregation, recipe BOM explosion, FEFO batch traceability.
15. **Fleet TMS & Digital e-POD Signature** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/fleet/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/fleet/)): Vehicle routing (VRP), fuel norm tracking, mobile electronic Proof of Delivery (e-POD).
16. **B2B Wholesale Portal & Credit Limit Engine** ([https://khanhdp.com/apps/b2b/](https://khanhdp.com/apps/b2b/)): Tiered dealer pricing matrix, automated credit limit lockout (`@kt/b2b-credit`), container order tracking.
17. **35 `@kt/*` Enterprise Architecture Suites**: Reusable TypeScript monorepo packages covering `@kt/einvoice-vn`, `@kt/audit-trail`, `@kt/tenant-guard`, `@kt/resilient-cache`, `@kt/wallet-ledger`, `@kt/bom-inventory`, `@kt/fleet-routing`, `@kt/geocoding-routing`, `@kt/offline-sync`, and `@kt/anti-spam`.
